authority_statement: Ignition selects provider. Provider does not select Ignition behavior.
precedence_constraints: Explicit user provider preference cannot override operation fit, admission, permission, authentication or provenance gates.
A provider health result cannot create a Current capability or a permission.
A provider cannot widen, rewrite or select the Ignition operation being requested.
Provider-local routing, install, cookie/browser/session and fallback rules are evidence about that provider only and cannot become Ignition policy.
If no candidate passes the operation/environment gates, return UNAVAILABLE_NO_SAFE_PROVIDER or an explicitly allowed fallback; do not force a provider.

steps: Normalize the requested abstract operation, input types, output types, side-effect ceiling, network/auth ceiling and provenance requirement.
Build the candidate set from provider records and any separately observed native/bounded candidates; provider IDs are not exhaustive.
Apply hard gates for contract validity, operation fit, environment availability, permission/authentication ceiling, side-effect ceiling and required provenance/validator receipt.
Apply an explicit user provider constraint if present; an invalid or unavailable explicit request fails closed rather than bypassing a gate.
Rank surviving candidates using the operation's declared policy over the nine selection inputs; there is no universal provider-name or provider-local ordering.
Select only a candidate whose result can be captured and validated; otherwise return no safe provider or an allowed fallback with a reason.

provider_local_policy_test.fixture: Agent Reach skill-level instruction that the skill must be used for listed platform access

candidate_decisions.reason: The Contract R0 record and pinned health observation fit a derived-artifact spike, subject to Step05 input/IR/receipt validation.
Only a public read-only channel with a separately captured result may proceed; pinned-source health remains dependency-blocked and the installed executable observation is not source admission.
Task149 does not grant authenticated-channel admission, regardless of provider-local capability or local credentials.

claim_ceiling: Ignition-owned provider-selection authority and bounded candidate-selection rules only. This policy does not prove provider quality, Current integration, production readiness, authenticated-channel admission, external truth, Owner acceptance or live external invocation.
